gonna edit as i listen!

blue blood: the vibes in this song are immaculate, on the same stage as my satisfaction for me. they sound amazing on this track!!

I AM: this is an amazing title track, nuff said.

kitsch: it took me a while to warm up to the chorus when this dropped, but the verses and prechorus are amazing.

lips: this song is pop music to a tea, a simple cute bop. i love the instrumental for this track, and the little guitar thing to transition into the rap verse from rei and gaeul. liz’s parts stand out a lot here.

heroine: this one didn’t make a huge first impression on me i’d say. the lyrics seem like they’d be good from what i understood, but i wasn’t the biggest fan of the ooh nanana part

mine: this one is really pretty, liz and yujin sound great here. the chorus has a really chill and elegant / pretty vibe. really suits the girls.

hypnosis: that opening almost scared me, but considering the title of the song it made sense. wonyoung sounds very alluring and mysterious in this one. the electronic vibes feel kind of love dive-esque but not really. idk how to describe it. LIZ’s PART(s) THO??? liz you’re amazing. also rei’s flow here is kinda fire. way too short though….

not your girl: already heard this one of course, but it’s a very fun lighthearted vibe, again liz sounds amazing!!! super catchy too. this just makes you feel good!!!

next page: liz starting the song… she’s really blowing it out of the water. she sounds so amazing whenever she sings, i just love her so much. she adds so much texture to their music. this song is lovely. it was interesting to have the rap part sort of “muffled”. the “can i make you mine” was really catchy too.

cherish: this one really intrigued me in the highlight medley, and it didn’t disappoint me. i love yujin and liz at the beginning. as a singing duo they don’t disappoint. i love the way wonyoung sounds in the prechorus. the chorus is really cool, i like the back and forth of rap / talk singing to “regular” singing. piano at the end was nice.

shine with me: this also stood out to me in the highlight medley. more amazing vocals. knowing wonyoung wrote this to the fans, makes it all the more special. this song sounds like GLITTER. this album is super great. the vibes are elegant and pretty. it really suits these amazing girls.

IN CONCLUSION: LIZ.

text:
My first thoughts (editing/adding when I'm done listening):

Blue Blood : Nice, a good opener, but I feel like the song doesn't really go anywhere? I'd say a solid 7/10 for me

I AM: it's a great title. 9/10 because some passages sound a bit empty to me but overall really good.

Kitsch: I instantely liked this song when it came out and still think it holds up great. I don't think the place in the tracklist makes too much sense, having it directly after I AM is a bit overwhelming. But the song is still a 9/10.

Lips: Ohhh I really really like this! 9/10, maybe even 10/10 in a few days, it's definitely added to my playlist.

Heroine: It's nice. I like their voices, they sound really good in this. Also the brige buildup to the last chorus is >>>. A good b-side, not extraordinary but solid. I think the rating may improve with more listens. 7.5/10

Mine: The first neutral song for me. It's not bad, I wouldn't play it again though. 5/10

Hypnosis: that intro, I almost thought my headphones broke. Changes up the sound, I like that! The rythm is definitely hypnotizing. The song itself isn't it for me, but I applaud them for doing something different so bonus points for that 6/10.

NOT YOUR GIRL: Ohh it's cute. It's fun. An instant mood boster. It reminds me of the songs that are played during a makeover montage in a teen movie. 9/10, will add this to my getting ready playlist for sure.

Next Page: I'm really not sure what to think of this song. I do like it, but also something is missing I just don't really know what? Unfortunately only a 6/10 so far.

Cherish: I like the pre-chorus. The chorus itself falls a bit flat for me. It's a nice song and a good b-side but a bit too repetitive for my taste. The girls sound good though. It's also mixing up style and tempo quite a lot which is nice. 7/10.

Shine With Me: A classic closing ballad. The lyrics are really good and feel very personal - this is a song for DIVE right? 8.5/10.

Overall: The album has some solid bangers and good b-sides. Some songs fall a bit flat for me but with 11 songs in an album that's completely okay and to be expected, and maybe those songs are the favorite songs of other people (I'm seeing a lot of people being into Hyponsis!) . Overall they offer a good variety of styles, sounds and themes all while maintaining a certain IVE-style. It's a great album, one I'll definitely come back to listen often (and maybe even order a physical copy).

text:
BLUE BLOOD: Strong opener. Interesting instrumental. It would work very well as an opener for their tours similar to aespa’s AENERGY.

I AM: Pop heaven for a Pop Brat like me. The notes are a bit too high at some points, but it’s a very catchy tune. I love the second verse. Gaeul’s rap is a great break from the high-pitched nature of the song. Liz, Liz, Liz! She sounds lovely.

KITSCH: I liked it when I first heard it and still do but listening to this album and comparing it to their previous tracks, it’s pretty basic and doesn’t stick out in any particular way. The verses are good, but reminiscent of early to mid-2010s pop with a tiny hint of nostalgia. The chorus, while an earworm, is repetitive and kind of throws the song off in a way. I’m not sure if it’s in an entirely bad way, just that it feels odd. The rap bridge was … interesting. I like the way the pre-chorus sounds after the bridge, though.

LIPS: It’s a mood, it’s a vibe, it’s paradise. It’s a cute little summer beach tune (we southern hemisphere citizens are heading into winter soon but okay). Nothing much to say. It’s just cute!

HEROINE: Vocals are great. That whoo na-na-na-na section took me by surprise but I love it. The track doesn’t stick out in a particularly good or bad way.

MINE: This is the track that I claimed from the highlight melody and I’m happy to report that it has not disappointed me. I love the melody and the “bounciness” of the song. It reminds me of a very specific sound from the early to mid-2010s in a good way. I really like the tempo, the instrumental, and the way it’s sung. The section that they used for the snippet from the highlight medley is very catchy. I really like this song and it’s going on my daily playlist.

HYPNOSIS: It makes me feel like an under-the-radar badass. “Cool” is the only word that I can use to describe this song. I like the instrumental and whatever’s happening in the background. It’s what SHOOT and Gas Me Up are to ITZY. It also sounds like it could have been a track on aespa's Savage album. Maybe even the Girls album (Illusion's sister).

NOT YOUR GIRL: I’m first and foremost a Pop Brat and this song is everything, everything, everything! It’s a song that very much lifts your spirit and puts you in a good mood. It’s got a catchy melody and good vibes. Love it! It’s too bright to put in my daily playlist, but there’s a place reserved for it somewhere on one of my main playlists.

NEXT PAGE: It’s nice. It’s got a filler-y quality about it, though. It doesn’t stick out as particularly good or bad. They sound great, though.

CHERISH: Groovy instrumental! Their vocals are lovely on the track. But my feelings about it are the same as Next Page.

SHINE WITH ME: It’s fine. Good, even. The instrumental is very pretty. It’s a bit too ballad-y for my taste, though, especially since my mood is all out of sorts (PMS) and I’m craving some upbeat music.

In conclusion, it’s a solid album. Some tracks stick out more than others, but that’s to be expected with a full album. The songs that didn’t hook me have the potential to grow on me. The songs that hooked me are among my favourite releases from the year so far. It's missing a strong track like My Satisfaction (which is still one of their best songs) but it's diverse enough to lay the foundation of what might become their signature sound.
label: Reasoned Opinion

text:
As I listen:

Blue Blood - I like that this sounds rather mysterious with a hint into more a dark tone. The melody after the chorus is a bit of a throwback to Eleven. I probably would have loved for this to go a little harder.

I AM - This is quite glamorous isn't it? It gives big such as After Like gave. I'm definitely a fan of this style.

Kitsch - Well. 19's Kitsch. I love the chorus up to the drop. It's a little grating but I got used to it and kinda like it now.

Lips - This is very low-key. It's a quite fun pop song. It's going to be perfect for spring I think.

Heroine - This somehow gives me major flashbacks to some of the more recent OMG songs which is not a bad thing. This is a cute little song that I will probably listen to more over the next month's.

Mine - I'm surprised that the songs seem mostly more on a low note, I kinda expected more hard hitting songs but I'm not mad. Again a really nice song, I like the change toward the end and I think this may be my fav b-side yet.

Hypnosis - I called it. Here we go. This is definitely more edgy then the other songs so far. Not my favourite but I like the change up in tone! A little surprised that it is kinda pp laced in between more mellow songs.

Not your girl - This is very pop and happy which is so different to Hypnosis. I kinda wished this came after Kitsch as it would have led a little nicer into the more mellow songs. Despite that, this is a nice song to listen to when the sun finally comes out and you feel good.

Next Page - This appeals to me quite a lot. This goes well with Heroine!

Cherish - A bit more attitude which I kinda expected for more songs. I like the flow of the song and I feel the line distribution is quite good here? I hear all of them for a decent amount of time.

Shine with me - Time to show off some vocals. A good end to this album.

Listening to all songs an relistening some songs I'm all in all quite happy that we got this album. I'm surprised that the songs have been more on the soft and pop side. I thought Eleven and Lovedive quite experimental but this album did not stray too much from the expected. I did find the order of the songs a bit strange with Hypnosis being kind of randomly in there.

Anyways I will get the album and I hope we get some great stages!
label: Reasoned Opinion

Standouts: Blue Blood, Lips, Mine, Next Page, and Shine With Me.

I'm a picky listener, so the fact that half of the album is going in my playlist is pretty incredible and speaks to the quality of these songs. My only complaint is that some of the songs didn't need a rap section inserted into them, (that's one of my issues with K-Pop in general), it's okay to have tracks that are pure vocals. Sadly though the title track and Kitsch are near the bottom of my list, I wish we got videos for other songs instead.

I will say that even for the songs that I didn't enjoy very much, they still added to the variety of this album. I'm sure everyone will find at least one song that they like.

If you enjoyed Eleven and Love Dive (which was my SOTY for 2022), you'll really like Blue Blood. It's got that goddess vibe that I've started to associate with Ive. Would have been a fantastic title IMO, and a chance to explore the darker side of Ive's music.

Lips, Mine, Next Page, and Shine With Me are just great listens in general, I can see myself putting these on repeat over and over again.

text:
Honestly, the girls sound great in almost every track, and Starship/producers really know how to distribute the lines in a way it fits perfectly (even Kitsch, despite the criminal lack of lines Liz got).

The production of all the songs deserves plaudits, it’s that good. It’s incredible and not something I normally point out.

Dare I compare Liz-Yujin as the fourth Gen’s Wendy-Seulgi? They killed that Heroine pre-chorus, amongst other standouts. They’re help set the tone for IVE music in the same way Wendy-Seulgi does, and my god they kill it. Same thing about Shine With Me. They sound so crazy gooood.

Wonyoung has this very sultry or dreamy vibe in her vocals too, depending on the song. They really maximize it well too.

Rei dropping that Exy flow for Lips and stands out in Hypnosis as well. Her vocal tone + ability to execute various rap flows make her one of my favorite 4th Gen rapper.

Gaeul/Leeseo is their flex vocal/rap and they fill it perfectly. They have moments where I’m surprised (I AM, Next Page, Cherish), and at this point I shouldn’t be.

Early AOTY candidate for me. It’s my kind of pop music and its incredibly well-done as well. I can’t even choose a standout song because they sound so good in all of them. Also, I’ve said it in After Like and I’ll say it again, Starship struck gold with this six-member lineup.

text:
I think IVE has the best discography of any 4th gen idol, and this is simply because the way the music leans towards the strengths of their members. This album is genuinely one of my favourite ones ever just because of how fast I actually enjoyed listening to the album. It's an easy listen and fun to relisten to.

I love B-sides as much as the next guy, but I'm glad the stand-out title track is the best track on the album, because there'll be more videos and clips of them performing it live. I AM is genuinely the best title track to be released this year IMO - which I genuinely did not see coming after how much I enjoyed NMIXX's Love Me Like This - which also had really cool vocals. Also, lyrics wise, Kim Eana doesn't disappoint. What a star.

B-sides are amazing, the highlight for me is Hypnosis because that chorus slaps & I'm pretty sure the live performances for this will be fun. I liked that some of the members got their reps in with regards to songwriting, because it was pretty fun to listen to those songs as well with the added context.

I do find it interesting that Kitsch was the song chosen for the pre-release MV - especially considering how jarring the song is. I personally have it as my least favourite song just because of the chorus and I know that's necessarily not an uncommon opinion. I would have liked Hypnosis, Blue Blood or Lips as the pre-release, but then again what do I know HAHAHA.

Anyways what does this album name mean. I have IVE? I guess that makes sense, I'm just imagining how'd they introduce the album as IVE's IVE IVE.

---

Blue Blood: As mentioned, My Satisfaction vibes. I understand why this wasn't a title track, but this is definitely one for the live performances. Fun little song.

I AM: Song of the year. Was convinced once that snippet released on TikTok with Liz's chorus. The vocals on this are amazing to the point where there is genuinely no weak/boring part of the song. I'm genuinely tired of the empty choruses, so big fan of this booming loud chorus with the singing in unison.

Kitsch: Not my thing, still isn't - and this is specific to the chorus. Everything else is really fun though.

Lips: Pure pop. Just good shit. Also, Liz. This is the definition of a good B-side. Not necessarily reinventing the wheel, but just pure quality, good vocals, and good structure.

Heroine: Fun little chorus with what I can only describe as "tantalizing oh na-na-nas". I like those kind of switch-ups.

Mine: Again, just good shit. Definition of good B-side part 2.

Hypnosis: Intro is going to divide opinions, but that chorus slaps. One for the live performances for sure. Also, Liz (part 2).

Not Your Girl: What a swerve off Hypnosis, but fun lighthearted song. Reminds me of OH MY GIRL tbh with the na-na-nas and bouncy pop stuff and I personally am not in the mood to appreciate that fully now, but I'm sure I'll come back to it and enjoy it eventually.

Next Page: Didn't stand out to me - a good song, but honestly one I'll put in the background and not really notice. Not necessarily a bad thing.

Cherish: That chorus is really fun honestly. Good stuff.

Shine With Me: Good album sequencing and good choice to end the album. Fun melancholic song with a big vocal emphasis. Like a graceful ending to a long show, which I've IVE was.
label: Reasoned Opinion

text:
Starship cranked up the auto-tune and vocal compression on this whole album ruining some otherwise good songs and hurting some otherwise great songs.

Blue Blood is the best Ive song since Love Dive. I still don't like the digitized effect on their voices, but it doesn't stand out much with this type of music.

Lips could have been amazing but not only do they continue to F with the members voices with the same digitization, they also applied weird audio compression filters; It's especially bad when Leeseo comes in at 14 and Wonyoung at 28 where their voices sound like an early 2000s Napster ripped 8khz audio file that's been re-encoded 10 times.

Heroine is good, but uninspired.

Mine isn't for my taste. Not bad, just not for me.

Hypnosis is just ugly sounding all around.

Not Your Girl is similar to Lips. This could have been amazing except for the effects on their voices.

The last 3 just feel like fillers. The only notable thing is they cranked the autotune up to Cher and TPain levels on Shine with Me, and that's not a compliment.
label: Reasoned Opinion
